node_definition.done_when: Every clause of the plan's s12 done-when that names the worker holds. reckon/serve.py resolves the served log path once per server object, the first time it handles a request, keeps it on that object (reached by every Handler as self.server), and uses it for every access line and every bound check made for that server's requests. A new tests/test_a_served_log_keeps_the_home_it_started_under.py builds a bare ThreadingHTTPServer around serve.Handler under one temporary home, serves one binding request, and moves RECKON_HOME to a second temporary home that stands in for the operator's and never names the real one. Case 1: a change stream opened before the move closes after it, the first home's log carries its closing line and the second home has no log; control: resolve the access line's path per line again, and the second home gains the line. Case 2: after the binding request and before the move, lower the log bound and write the first home's log past it; after the move a request rotates the first home's log, leaving its predecessor, and creates nothing in the second home; control: resolve the bound check's path per call again, and the first home's log is never rotated. Each control is applied, run, logged with its failing id, and reversed in a trap, and git status --porcelain afterwards lists only the .venv and .env links. tests/test_every_module_fits_a_worker_window.py passes. The new test file and tests/test_cross_node_writes_refresh_the_index.py pass with -n 4 at most and a per-run --basetemp; the coordinator runs the server-importer population and the whole-file scratch-home acceptance at merge. Every log sits under the run directory with a revision header and ends in EXIT=, suites run on the fleet allocation and not the login node. Write status complete as your very last action and run nothing after it.
